verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents named user API tokens with expiration and personal API keys for headless agent or MCP use. Interactive agents get a per-client OAuth 2.1 connection approved in the browser, so agents can receive distinct, time-limited credentials. Nothing shows those credentials can be narrowed to specific workspaces, resources, or read-only actions; personal keys appear to carry the user's full privileges. Missing for 10: permission scopes or roles on API tokens, least-privilege or read-only agent credentials, per-agent service accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
